suite: complete locked v2; 49 tasks, 866 synthetic public cases
scoring: choice: native choice; noul: returned rounded probability >= 0.5; score: returned rounded distribution argmax, first level tie; never round expected score
raw_probabilities: Capture float32 softmax of original head logits in same official systemone call, no second forward. Raw prediction differences disclosed, not used to correct native answers.
inference: one exact upstream instruction/criteria/state per request, fixed question id decision; unchanged official BF16 head; no generation, truncation, sampling, retry, answer correction or fallback
condition_order: sort six condition names by SHA256('classifier-benchmark-v2-v1:condition:'+name), fixed before first inference
case_order: upstream task/case file order common to every condition
warmups: exactly first upstream case of each primitive, 3 per condition, excluded from scores
storage: verified external Models APFS USB volume UUID 99B50D1F-26DA-4175-BCB3-5D4852B1C5FB only; offline existing assets; no download/conversion/cache/internal output fallback
concurrency: one additional model worker at a time; original CLEF services and unrelated services left intact; counters/resource snapshots before and after; no globally locked latency claim
errors: fatal technical error stops preserving partial evidence, no automatic retries; necessary repair requires transparent amendment and continuation of unfinished work only
primary: equal-task macro accuracy, four quant contrasts vs same-runtime BF16 GGUF; paired task-vector bootstrap 100000 samples with NumPy PCG64 seed 20261007; percentile two-sided 95% intervals; centered paired bootstrap two-sided p values with +1 correction; Holm correction across four primary quant contrasts
secondary: micro/task/primitive accuracy; paired correctness transitions versus both BF16 controls; ordinal score MAE/within-one; binary AUC/probability error; Brier/clipped NLL(1e-12)/10 equal-width top-confidence ECE and reliability by task/primitive; latency/resources descriptive
interpretation: public synthetic suite not held-out confirmation, not validated difficulty; task resampling descriptive generalization among these tasks; no broad intelligence or monotonic benefit claim
